external_entities.name: member
external_entities.description: A grocery loyalty programme member who uses the mobile app and authorizes partner apps.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Members collect points when they shop and spend them on gift cards.

external_entities.name: partner app
external_entities.description: A web application operated by another company that can access member points.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Partner apps are web applications that other companies run on their own servers

external_entities.name: browser
external_entities.description: The browser used for member sign-in and authorization redirects.
external_entities.source_excerpt: A member who connects a partner app signs in on the authorization server's sign-in page in their browser

processes.name: mobile app
processes.description: The mobile application through which members authenticate and call the rewards API.
processes.notes: The app keeps a refresh token on the phone.

processes.name: authorization server
processes.description: The server that authenticates members, issues authorization codes, refresh tokens, consents, and access tokens.
processes.source_excerpt: The app signs a member in through our authorization server with the authorization code flow
processes.notes: Nobody wrote down whether the app sends a PKCE challenge. Nobody decided an idle timeout for the authorization-server sign-in.

processes.name: rewards API
processes.description: The API used to read and write the points ledger and redeem points for gift cards.
processes.source_excerpt: The rewards API reads and writes the points ledger
processes.notes: The API does not check which client or which audience a token was issued for.

processes.name: support console
processes.description: A web application that closes a member's account.
processes.source_excerpt: The support console is a web app that closes a member's account.

data_stores.name: identity database
data_stores.description: Database containing member identity data and authorization artifacts.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The authorization server keeps member accounts, email addresses and password hashes in the identity database

data_stores.name: points ledger
data_stores.description: Ledger containing member balances and points transactions.
data_stores.source_excerpt: the points ledger, which holds every member's balance and every points transaction

data_stores.name: API log store
data_stores.description: Store containing every request received by the rewards API, including headers.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The rewards API also writes every request it receives, headers included, to the API log store.

data_flows.name: sign in
data_flows.description: Member sign-in at the authorization server.
data_flows.source_excerpt: A member who connects a partner app signs in on the authorization server's sign-in page in their browser

data_flows.name: authenticate member
data_flows.description: The mobile app authenticates a member through the authorization server.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The app signs a member in through our authorization server with the authorization code flow
data_flows.notes: Nobody wrote down whether the app sends a PKCE challenge.

data_flows.name: call rewards API
data_flows.description: The mobile app calls the rewards API with an access token.
data_flows.source_excerpt: then calls the rewards API with the access token it gets back

data_flows.name: approve consent
data_flows.description: Member approval of the partner-app consent screen and requested scopes.
data_flows.source_excerpt: approves a consent screen that lists the scopes

data_flows.name: request tokens
data_flows.description: A partner app sends token requests using its client secret.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The partner app sends that secret in the body of its token requests.
data_flows.notes: Every partner app receives every scope.

data_flows.name: return authorization code
data_flows.description: The authorization server returns an authorization code to the partner app's redirect URI.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The browser then returns to the partner app's redirect URI with an authorization code.

data_flows.name: store identity data
data_flows.description: The authorization server stores member accounts and authorization artifacts in the identity database.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The authorization server keeps member accounts, email addresses and password hashes in the identity database, together with the authorization codes, refresh tokens and consents it issues.
data_flows.data_description: Accounts, email addresses, password hashes, authorization codes, refresh tokens, and consents

data_flows.name: read-write points
data_flows.description: The rewards API reads and writes the points ledger.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The rewards API reads and writes the points ledger

data_flows.name: write request logs
data_flows.description: The rewards API writes received requests and headers to the API log store.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The rewards API also writes every request it receives, headers included, to the API log store.

data_flows.name: close member account
data_flows.description: The support console marks a member account closed in the identity database.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Closing an account marks it closed in the identity database.
data_flows.notes: Nothing happens to that member's refresh tokens.

data_flows.name: obtain access token
data_flows.description: The support console obtains access tokens from the authorization server.
data_flows.source_excerpt: It takes access tokens from the same authorization server

trust_boundaries.name: our cloud account
trust_boundaries.description: The cloud account where the platform components and stores run.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: Everything below runs in our own cloud account

trust_boundaries.name: member phone
trust_boundaries.description: The member-controlled phone hosting the mobile app.

trust_boundaries.name: partner server
trust_boundaries.description: Servers operated by other companies that host partner apps.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: partner apps that other companies run on their own servers

assumptions.assumption: The identity database contains confidential data because it stores member personal information, password hashes, and tokens.
assumptions.basis: The source states that the store contains member accounts, email addresses, password hashes, authorization codes, refresh tokens, and consents.

assumptions.assumption: The points ledger contains confidential data because it stores member balances and points transactions.
assumptions.basis: The source states that the ledger holds every member's balance and every points transaction.

assumptions.assumption: The API log store contains confidential data because it stores complete requests and headers.
assumptions.basis: The source states that every request received by the rewards API, headers included, is written to the store.

assumptions.assumption: The rewards API is internet-facing because it is served on the same public hostname as the rewards API and support console.
assumptions.basis: The source states that the support console is served on the same public hostname as the rewards API.

assumptions.assumption: The support console is internet-facing because it is served on a public hostname.
assumptions.basis: The source states that the support console is served on the same public hostname as the rewards API.
